text:
Maya K: Heads up — PR #8690 keeps failing CI on snapshots for linux-stable. Failing only on test_cache_integration::test_cache_eviction. Anyone seen this pattern before? :eyes:

Ravi V: I pushed an updated snapshot earlier (commit f2c3b1) but CI still flakes. Locally it passes ~80% of runs. Failing assertion looks like a small timing/order diff in the eviction list.

CI Bot: Build 8690.3 failed on ubuntu-20.04 (linux-stable). Job: //tests:cache_integration (shard 2). Log excerpt:
```
E   AssertionError: Lists differ:
E   - ['a', 'b', 'c']
E   + ['b', 'a', 'c']
E   assert ['b', 'a', 'c'] == ['a', 'b', 'c']
```

Jon (infra): FYI the staging CI queue is long atm (~120 pending). Reruns are being queued ~20-40m. We're rolling an autoscaler fix (see #1021) but rollout hasn't finished in all regions.

Maya K: ack. Is there a way to run just that shard or trigger a faster runner? Waiting 30m will block a few merges.

Jon (infra): You can trigger a targeted re-run from the GitHub UI (Re-run jobs -> Re-run failed jobs) or call our internal rerun command: `/ci rerun --job //tests:cache_integration --shard 2 --quick-run` (this will prefer fast runners if capacity). If that times out, you can also run the test locally with the same backend:```bash
pytest tests/test_cache_integration.py::test_cache_eviction -q -k eviction -q
# or run with dockerized linux env: ./scripts/dev/run_tests.sh --target cache_integration
```

Sasha: Quick note — if the failure is just ordering and the snapshot diff is stable, updating snapshot is OK but only after confirming flakiness isn't masking a bug. LGTMs don't count until CI is green. :thumbsup:

Ravi V: Re-ran the single test on a fast runner (via `/ci rerun`) 3x, 2x passed, 1x failed. Stack trace points to eviction order being nondeterministic under heavy concurrency. I'm going to add a small deterministic sort in the test to stabilize if it's safe, then re-run full suite.

Jon (infra): Recommend also rebase onto main — autoscaler fix merged there earlier (PR #1021) which may reduce queue pressure for you. If you need a hot path, I can manually bump priority for one rerun.

Maya K: Thanks — rebased and kicked a rerun. If it still flakes, Ravi, can you push the sort patch + a short note in the test about why it's OK? We'll hold merge until green.

Ravi V: Will do. Patch ready, adding test comment and a tiny change:```diff
- evicted = list(evicted_set)
- assert evicted == ['a','b','c']
+ evicted = sorted(list(evicted_set))  # stable ordering to avoid nondeterministic failures
+ assert evicted == ['a','b','c']
```

CI Bot: Rerun queued (8690.4) — priority bumped by Jon (infra). Expected start ~5m.

Maya K: Thanks everyone. If 8690.4 is still flaky after these changes, ping me and I'll open a tiny follow-up to add a retry wrapper around the sensitive assertion.

Sasha: :eyes: and thanks for handling the priority bump, Jon.

Jon (infra): np. ping here when it's green and I'll mark the autoscaler rollout as observed for your region.
